task.instruction: Identify a course on Coursera related to 'Artificial Intelligence for Healthcare' and note the course duration along with the number of quizzes in Assessments.

final_answer:
I found a matching course: **Foundations of AI in Healthcare** by SkillUp (the first course in Coursera's "Artificial Intelligence for Healthcare" specialization, which itself runs 3 months at 2–3 hours per week).

**Course duration:** 8 hours to complete (4 modules — Introduction to AI in Healthcare; Ethics, Regulation, and Responsible AI in Healthcare; Machine Learning Applications in Healthcare; and Final Project, Exam, and Wrap-Up)

**Quizzes/assessments:** The Assessments section lists **13 assignments** in total. Per module, that breaks down as 4 assignments in Module 1, 4 in Module 2, 4 in Module 3, and 1 assignment plus 1 peer review in the final module.

So: 8 hours, 13 assessments (graded assignments). If you'd prefer the whole specialization's figures instead — 12 weeks / 3 courses (8, 11 and 9 hours) — I can pull the assessment counts for the other two courses as well.

judge.rationale: Final answer cites a Coursera course page showing “Foundations of AI in Healthcare,” “8 hours to complete,” and “Assessments: 13 assignments.”

final_page.title: Foundations of AI in Healthcare | Coursera
